source_of_truth: This block is the only source of numeric token, context, model, reasoning, concurrency, retry, validation and usage-budget policy. orchestration-engine/core/token-governance.md explains it; generators, the engine governor and host hooks read it.
principle: Maximum useful work per unit of context and usage. Cheapest capable model and reasoning for the actual task.

authority.rule: Yuli sets the Mission Budget Plan. Ori enforces it at dispatch time. Yuli never dispatches workers; Ori never raises the budget.

concurrency.parallel_rule: Two concurrent agents only when their scopes are disjoint and at most one of them writes. Parallel writers stay off until worktree isolation exists.
above_normal_requires: files and scopes do not overlap
justification is recorded in the mission audit
concurrency.coordinator_threads: Yuli and Ori run as distinct logical stages in the main thread. Host-native runtimes never spawn Yuli or Ori as subagent threads.
concurrency.validation_agent_lifetime: spawn Valdi only when the artifact is ready; release immediately after the verdict

only_when: the previous level failed with evidence

research.stop_condition: stop once sufficient evidence answers the bounded question

retry.attempt_2: only when the corrective action is classified and clear
retry.attempt_3: REPLAN only: change at least one of context scope, specialist, reasoning or model; never repeat the same worker, context and model
retry.after_ceiling: BLOCKED for Ori re-planning; the Owner only for Owner-level matters listed in owner_escalation

validation.cycles_per_task: 1 initial validation + 1 revalidation per repair cycle, bounded by the retry ceiling

agent_packet_excludes: the full Andy current.json (the engine compact previous-state digest is allowed)

checkpoint.writer: main thread only; dispatched agents never read or write Andy state

platform.codex: session rollout token_count: tokens + rate_limits primary (5h) and secondary (weekly) used_percent
platform.claude: claude -p JSON: modelUsage tokens and total_cost_usd per call; quota percentage UNAVAILABLE

telemetry.proxy: work units = class weight x reasoning multiplier per dispatch, against the Mission Budget Plan
telemetry.rule: Platform quota and the internal work budget are different things. Record the source on every reading; never fabricate platform telemetry.

usage_governor.default_budget_rule: without a Yuli plan: max(default_mission_work_units[complexity], task_count x default_per_task_work_units); 9 = one STANDARD/medium dispatch (3 units) x the 3-attempt retry ceiling

YELLOW.behavior: reduce context duplication; no optional parallelism

ORANGE.behavior: no new optional agents; no model escalation; finish the current bounded phase; checkpoint aggressively

RED.behavior: stop spawning; finish only the safe atomic operation; Andy checkpoint; return resumable state (not an Owner escalation)

usage_governor.effective_ratio: max(platform used fraction when available, proxy ratio)

questions: Can the current bounded worker finish this?
Is the requested model and reasoning justified?
spawn_policy.default: DO NOT SPAWN without a strong justification

main_authority.origin: AUTONOMY-RECOVERY WP-1 (Authority Lock): Main = Host only, Governor = Guard only
main_may: state, evidence, plan and git plumbing
main_authority.enforcement: guard hook, main thread only: implementation write -> ledger MAIN_IMPLEMENTATION_WRITE (report.main_implementation_writes); denied when the mission was set with --host-only
main_authority.residual: PARTIAL text heuristic for shell writes (a dynamically built command is not recognised); inline interpreter scripts (python - <<EOF, python -c, node -e, powershell here-strings) with a write call are treated as implementation writes unless every path-like token is plumbing or outside the project root, and a script with no statically resolvable path is denied conservatively; a script file run by name (python script.py) or a dynamically assembled path is not seen; not an OS sandbox

runtime_watchdog.origin: ALIGN-2 RESOURCE GOVERNANCE HOTFIX (ALIGN-3 WP-3a incident: general-purpose worker, 104 model calls, 363K context, HTTP 429)

admission.rule: dt-* only with an installed definition (frontmatter maxTurns/model). Host built-in types only with a complete one-line DT_AGENT_CONTRACT json bound to the active mission. Never unrestricted general-purpose.

runtime_watchdog.access_enforcement: tool time: access=read denies Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit; access=write limits those tools to the contract files allowlist; shell writes are DECLARED (not parsed). Live sibling and crashed-agent usage files count toward WP / mission totals.

quota.action: QUOTA_EVENT in the ledger; new spawns denied until main-thread CLI quota-clear --reason

telemetry.turns_and_context: host subagent transcript <transcripts>/<session_id>/subagents/agent-<agent_id>.jsonl (assistant message ids + usage), read incrementally
telemetry.fallback: PROXY: tool-call counter + elapsed time when the transcript is unavailable
telemetry.enforcement: deny of every further tool call (exit 2); hooks cannot kill a running agent

runtime_watchdog.main_thread: not governed by the watchdog (no subagent identity in hook payloads); bounded by discipline and Andy checkpoints

codex.mechanism: config.toml [agents] table plus a per-agent model in .codex/agents/*.toml

project_profile.scope: EG_SKIILS roots and NPT-generated projects (project-scoped .codex/config.toml); global ~/.codex/config.toml untouched (Owner decisions ALIGN-2, ALIGN-3 D3)
project_profile.effective_scope: only when Codex starts at Skills_IL/EG-SKIILS or the EG_SKIILS root (no .git: project root = cwd); sessions started in subfolders fall back to the global config (PARTIAL, ALIGN-2 evidence); for NPT-generated projects the project root follows Codex root detection (git root when .git exists); behaviour without .git or from subfolders is UNKNOWN until offline proof

claude.mechanism: admission hook dream-team/hooks/agent_governor.py: installed matchers: PreToolUse Agent|Task -> pre; PreToolUse * -> guard (state protection on Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash|PowerShell; runtime watchdog on every subagent tool call); PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure Agent|Task -> post; SubagentStop -> stop; per-agent model, effort and maxTurns frontmatter. Residual: fail-closed covers governor exceptions only; a hook timeout or missing interpreter is treated by Claude Code as non-blocking (PARTIAL)
claude.explicit_model_reason: general-purpose defaults to the parent session model; Dream Team agents carry an explicit model in their frontmatter

cursor.mechanism: PARTIAL: Task tool with per-task model slug (observed 2026-09-24); concurrency, depth and reasoning UNSUPPORTED; model per Task UNVERIFIED for generated agents (model: inherit); Ori must pass Task.model; rule text only (Cursor stays MANUAL)
cursor.model_per_task: UNVERIFIED for generated agents; Ori must pass Task.model
cursor.agent_banner: Model control: UNVERIFIED — generated agent inherits the session model; Ori must pass Task.model explicitly. Reasoning/concurrency/depth: UNSUPPORTED in Cursor.
cursor.main_thread_line: Main-thread stage; do not spawn as a subagent.

grok.mechanism: no native subagents; engine governor applies when routed
